A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''starship''' from the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] was discovered drifting through deep space during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The derelict [[Starship/Legends|starship]] carried lost artifacts from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Lost Sith Warship}}</ref> that had been evacuated prior to the [[post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
